LNG export marine terminal (2 x 225,000 m3, 2 berths, 28 MTPA)
Berth 1 arms on the platform, south to north: LA-6101 liquid, LA-6102 vapour, LA-6103 hybrid, LA-6104 liquid (S-01); drawn left to right L, L, H, V.
16 inch, ~4,000 m3/h per liquid arm; the hybrid runs as the third liquid arm or, in line-up (b), the second vapour path; the vapour arm LA-6102 is needed for every transfer (D-032).
ESD-2 trips ESD-1 at once (C&E I-603 into I-601); the ERS valves (two ball valves either side of the emergency release coupler) close 5 s later by I-607, not on ESD-1;
ERS valves de-energise-to-trip on 2oo2 solenoids, channels A / B (XA-6130A / B, either lost: ESD-1); couplers UY-6135..6138 release on ERS closed or timeout (D-034).
Thermal relief (15.0 barg) to D-6101: PSV-6171 / 6173 / 6174 per liquid arm section, PSV-6118 on the drain pump discharge. Vapour arm connected first, disconnected last (S-01).
D-6101 sits at the platform low point (drawn above the header). Its vent BOG-6002 has no valve: it is the drum's relief path and stays open.
XV-6123 / XV-6125: open-command permissives, each opens only with the other proven closed (ZSC-6123 / ZSC-6125, C&E I-604 / I-605), never trip an open valve; key interlock at the arm (vendor).
Arm purge (D-026): before loading the N2 goes into the carrier's manifold (S-01); after loading the arms drain to D-6101 and the purge N2 leaves by the drum vent BOG-6002 into the vapour return.
HV-6119 normally closed (pump vent/drain). BOG-6003, DR-6002 to DR-6007, LNG-6005, LNG-6007, N-6001: see the line list. Arm vents, drains, vapour arm N2 test point: arm package; O2: AI-6126.
Air failure: PZT-8123A/B/C (P-08, C&E I-804) trip ESD-1 first; XV-6101 and the arm isolations hold on accumulators, closing at their set speed; ERS valves hydraulic (HPU).
O2 above 5 vol % (AI-6126): C&E I-614 closes XV-6122 / XV-6125 with XV-6101 proven closed (ZSC-6101), else ESD-1 (I-601); ZSO-6122 not open in a transfer: ESD-1.
ESD-1: HS-6100A/B/C, XS-6108, XA-6130A / B; ESD-2: HS-6107A/B/C. XS-6100 'no carrier' mode ends on an arm unstowed or link healthy (D-034).
